script_segment: A small painted marker followed this story from start to finish.

script_segment: But engineers had shortened the support cables to save on cost.

script_segment: Within months the deck began to twist wildly in the wind.

caption: The deck began to twist wildly in the wind

script_segment: The bridge finally collapsed into the river below.
prompt: suspension bridge collapsing into a river
caption: The bridge collapsed into the river below

script_segment: Every bridge engineered since has studied exactly why it fell.
